name: Planar Horizons
blurb: Ten painted sets of five: full-art basic cycles, shocklands, fetchlands, channel lands and iconic realms.
blurbEs: Diez sets pintados de cinco: ciclos de tierras básicas, shocklands, fetchlands, tierras canal y reinos icónicos.

sets.name: Ukiyo Horizons
sets.style: Traditional Japanese woodblock landscape print (shin-hanga): flat layered sky gradients, crisp black key lines, subtle woodgrain paper texture, serene atmospheric distance.

items.subject: golden rice terraces and swaying pampas grass stretching toward pale mist-wrapped hills at dawn
a quiet pine-topped sea stack rising out of layered Prussian-blue coastal swells under a pale crescent moon
still dark lotus ponds and bent weeping willows shrouded in indigo twilight mist
a steep snow-dusted volcanic peak glowing coral-red in late afternoon sun above drifting clouds
towering cedar trunks and mossy stone steps vanishing into cool emerald mountain fog

sets.name: Celestial Atlas
sets.style: Astronomical watercolour and gold-ink landscape painting: twilight skies filled with subtle painted nebulae and brass-thin star arcs over calm silhouetted terrain.

items.subject: wide pale chalk downs and a lone standing stone beneath a sweeping arc of golden morning stars
a mirror-still lagoon reflecting towering star-strewn clouds and a quiet coral atoll
black mirror peat pools reflecting faint violet constellations between skeletal bog cypresses
jagged basalt spires silhouetted against a blazing meteor shower and warm crimson horizon
ancient silver-barked redwood giants parting overhead to frame a glowing emerald aurora

sets.name: Deco Metropolis
sets.style: Art Deco architectural gouache painting: towering geometric spires, stepped arches, brushed brass trim, dramatic sunlit diagonal shadows, clean crisp edges.

items.subject: a soaring white-marble stepped fountain plaza crowned with brass sun-arches and clear cascading pools
a cavernous Art Deco subterranean canal flanked by dark slate colonnades and dim teal bridge lamps
a grand crimson-lit iron foundry hall with towering geometric braziers and shadowed catwalks
wild red-brick ruins and cracked geometric pillars overtaken by massive tangled roots and mossy boulders
a sunlit glass-and-limestone conservatory atrium brimming with terraced cypresses and pale stone arches

sets.name: Wilderness Oil
sets.style: Classic Hudson River School oil painting: luminous atmospheric skies, sweeping natural panoramas, rich earthen pigments, visible canvas brushwork.

items.subject: a solitary white-stone cathedral ruin perched on a dark basalt crag under brooding silver storm clouds
towering coastal geysers sending sunlit white steam plumes over wet slate cliffs and turquoise surf
sunken mossy stone vaults half-swallowed by giant roots and soft emerald forest floor light
a cliffside sun-temple carved into red canyon rock, golden smelter rivers glowing inside its arches
crystal-clear terraced rainforest pools ringed with lush ferns, misty cliffs and bioluminescent lilies

sets.name: Frontier Fetches
sets.style: Cut-paper diorama and gouache landscape: crisp layered silhouettes, soft cast paper shadows between depth planes, rich earthy and mineral hues.

items.subject: rolling amber moors and leaning birch trees sweeping toward distant sun-washed green hills
crimson mineral pools winding through black volcanic mudflats and charred deadwood
layered red-ochre sandstone plateaus rising from a pale sunlit desert plain
silver-white salt marshes and dark peat channels stretching toward a quiet clouded horizon
a shadowed mossy ravine opening onto root-laced limestone crypt arches beneath thick canopy

sets.name: Kamigawa Scrolls
sets.style: Painted vertical silk-scroll landscape: delicate mineral pigments on warm silk, sweeping cloud bands, restrained gold-dust accents, calm vertical rhythm.

items.subject: a colossal ancient sky-piercing cedar tree cradling terraced wooden shrines among mist-wrapped boughs
graceful curved-roof pavilions resting on floating pale stone islands drifting through cerulean clouds
a half-submerged wooden torii gate and mossy lantern shrines in dark misty marsh waters
a serene white-walled mountain citadel crowned with golden eaves shining above sunlit clouds
steep crimson volcanic cliffs laced with glowing forge bridges and drifting ash plumes

sets.name: Monolith Realms
sets.style: Monumental fantasy oil painting in muted slate, ochre and bone tones: awe-inspiring architectural scale, tiny distant birds for proportion, moody overcast drama.

items.subject: a vast echoing limestone cavern lit by a pale shaft of daylight over an underground river and carved alcoves
a grand circular colonnade of marble pillars opening onto a deep starry night chasm
a colossal weathered iron ribcage half-sunk in black marsh water under heavy pewter clouds
a towering subterranean vault of dark obsidian pillars and dim bronze braziers stacked with ancient chests
an amorphous shifting stone bastion whose arched walls subtly resemble wings, antlers and shields

sets.name: Ancient Wonders
sets.style: Weathered fresco and tempera painting: mineral earth pigments, fine craquelure plaster texture, timeless mythic atmosphere, subdued natural lighting.

items.subject: endless misty moorland dotted with weathered standing stones and faint pale willow-wisps at dusk
a sheer abyssal glacier fissure where something impossibly vast sleeps beneath translucent blue-black ice
shattered marble columns and sun-bleached dust flats stretching under a stark pale sky
vast terraced quarry steps carved deep into rust-red stone under drifting dust and scaffolding
an immense sunlit forest amphitheatre formed by a ring of colossal ancient living trees around a golden glade

sets.name: Sanctuary Plates
sets.style: Hand-tinted copperplate landscape engraving: crisp architectural linework paired with soft hand-applied watercolour glazes in sage, slate blue and warm sandstone.

items.subject: a sprawling cathedral-like canopy of intertwined emerald boughs and mossy root bridges over sunlit ferns
a spiralling fortress of tall weathered stone corridors rising from misty coastal crags
a broken domed library half-submerged in a tranquil blue lagoon, brass astrolabes resting in the shallows
a dark terraced obsidian citadel built inside a hollow volcanic mountain mouth
graceful tiered timber halls perched beside a dramatic misty waterfall cascading into clear pools

sets.name: Old World Duals
sets.style: Classic 1990s fantasy gouache and watercolour illustration: warm sunlit nostalgia, soft atmospheric edges, rich organic pigments and traditional hand-painted charm.

items.subject: quiet snow-dusted alpine meadows and icy blue glacial streams under pale sunlit mountain peaks
a vast luminous subterranean ocean reflecting towering stalactites and deep indigo cavern vaults
eroded crimson canyon mesas and shadowy ravines glowing in warm copper sunset light
rugged spruce-clad mountain slopes rising into crisp misty granite ridges at golden hour
wide golden grasslands dotted with flat-topped acacia trees beneath a warm sweeping cloudscape
